Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Top Story Livestream: Newsfile discusses Obuasi SHTS abuse case, GH₵49m S.A. evacuation and World Cup visa scandal Source : Myjoyonline.com 24 October 2026 8:12am Audio By Carbonatix
This morning on Newsfile , host Samson Lardy Anyenini and his panellists will discuss the sexual abuse scandal at Obuasi Senior High Technical School and the GH¢49.72 million spent on evacuating 1,964 Ghanaians from South Africa.
The panel will also examine the World Cup visa scandal, which involves reports of a US$26,000 payment to the police on behalf of the suspended Director-General of the National Sports Authority, Yaw Ampofo Ankrah.
